arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
englishText: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

arabicText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّـهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
englishText: In the Name of Allāh,the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

arabicText: عَنْ فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ عَلَيْهَا اَلسلام بِنْتِ رَسُول ِاللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنَّها قالَتْ :
englishText: Fatimatuz-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet (s), peace be on them, is to have thus related ( an event ) :

arabicText: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي بَعْضِ الاْيَّامِ فَقالَ:
englishText: My father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, came to my house one day and said to me:

arabicText: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فاطِمَةُ
englishText: "Peace be on you, Fatimah"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: عَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ
englishText: I replied : "And upon you be peace"

arabicText: قالَ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي بَدَنِي ضُعْفا
englishText: Then he said : "I feel weakness in my body"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أُعِيذُكَ بِاللّهِ يَا أَبَتاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ
englishText: I said : "May Allah protect you from weakness, father"

arabicText: فَقَالَ: ”يَا فَاطِمَةُ! ٱئْتِينِي بِٱلْكِسَاءِ ٱلْيَمَانِيِّ فَغَطِّينِي بِهِ.
englishText: He said : "Fatimah, please bring the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it"

arabicText: فَأَتَيْتُهُ بالْكِساءِ الْـيَمانِي فَغَطَّيْتُهُ بِهِ
englishText: So, I brought the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it.

arabicText: وَصرْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذا وَجْهُهُ يَتَلَأَلَؤُ
englishText: Then, I looked at him and saw that his face was shining

arabicText: كَأَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِي لَيْلَة تَمامِهِ وَكَمالِهِ
englishText: like a full moon with its glory and splendor

arabicText: فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحَسَنِ عليه السلام قَدْ أَقْبَلَ
englishText: After a while, my son Hasan came in

arabicText: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ
englishText: and said : "Peace be on you, mother"

arabicText: فَقُلتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي
englishText: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"

arabicText: فَقَالَ: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
englishText: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet

arabicText: كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
englishText: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather is underneath the cloak"

arabicText: فَأَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
englishText: Hasan went near the cloak and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah;

arabicText: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: May I enter the cloak with you?"

arabicText: فَقالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا صاحِبَ حَوْضِي
englishText: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son and the master of my fountain (Kauthar),

arabicText: قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ ِ
englishText: you are given the permission to enter"

arabicText: فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ تَحْتَ الْكِساء
englishText: So, Hasan entered the cloak with him

arabicText: فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاَّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحُسَيْنِ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ وَقالَ
englishText: After a while, my Husain came in and said :

arabicText: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا أُمَّاهُ.
englishText: "Peace be on you, mother"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي.
englishText: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"

arabicText: فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
englishText: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet

arabicText: كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّهُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
englishText: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَأَخاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
englishText: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather and your brother are underneath the cloak"

arabicText: فَدَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: Husain stepped towards the cloak

arabicText: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنِ اخْتارَهُ اللّهُ
englishText: and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Chosen of Allah;

arabicText: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُما تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: May I enter the cloak with you?"

arabicText: فَقالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي
englishText: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son

arabicText: وَيَا شافِعَ أُمَّتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
englishText: and interceder of my followers, you are given the permission to enter"

arabicText: فَدَخَلَ مَعَهُما تَحْتَ الْكِساء
englishText: So, Husain entered the cloak with them.

arabicText: فَأَ قْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذلِكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طالِبٍ
englishText: After a while, Abul Hasan, Ali bin Abi Talib came in

arabicText: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللّهِ.
englishText: and said : "Peace be on you, O daughter of the Prophet (s) of Allah"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَيَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ.
englishText: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O father of Hasan, and the Commander of the faithful"

arabicText: فَقالَ: يَا فاطِمَةُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
englishText: He then said : "O Fatima! I smell a fragrance so sweet and so pure

arabicText: كَانَّهَا رائِحَةُ أَخِي وَابْنِ عَمِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
englishText: as that of my brother and my cousin, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

arabicText: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَلَدَيْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: I replied: "Yes. He is underneath the cloak with your two sons"

arabicText: فَأَقْبَلَ عَلِيٌّ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: So, Ali went near the cloak

arabicText: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
englishText: and said : "Peace be on you, Prophet (s) of Allah;

arabicText: وأَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: May I enter the cloak with you?"

arabicText: قالَ لَهُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَخِي ويَا وَصِيِّي
englishText: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my brother, my successor,

arabicText: وَخَلِيفَتِي وَصاحِبَ لِوَائِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ
englishText: my successor, and my standard bearer, you are given the permission to enter"

arabicText: فَدَخَلَ عَلِيٌّ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: So, Ali entered the cloak with them.

arabicText: ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: Then I stepped forward

arabicText: وَقُلْتُ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَتاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
englishText: and said : "Peace be on you, my father, O Prophet (s) of Allah;

arabicText: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: May I enter the cloak with you?"

arabicText: قالَ: وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يَا بِنْتِي وَيَا بِضْعَتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكِ
englishText: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my daughter, O part of myself; you are given the permission to enter"

arabicText: فَدَخَلْتُ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: So, I entered the cloak with them.

arabicText: فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنا جَمِيعاً تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ أَخَذَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّه بِطَرَفَي الْكِساءِ
englishText: Getting together underneath the cloak, my father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, held the two ends of the cloak

arabicText: وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْيُمْـنٰى إِلَى السَّماءِ وَقالَ:
englishText: and raised his right hand towards the heavens and prayed :

arabicText: اللّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَؤُلاءِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِي وَخاصَّتِي وَحامَّتِي
englishText: "O Allah, these are the people of my Household (Ahlul-Bayt). They are my confidants and my supporters.

arabicText: لَحْمُهُمْ لَحْمِي وَدَمُهُمْ دَمِي
englishText: Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood.

arabicText: يُؤْلِمُنِي مَا يُؤْلِمُهُمْ
englishText: Whoever hurts them, hurts me too.

arabicText: وَيَحْزُنُنِي مَا يَحْزُنُهُمْ
englishText: Whoever displeases them, displeases me too.

arabicText: أَنَا حَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حارَبَهُمْ
englishText: I am at war with those who are at war with them.

arabicText: وَسِلْمٌ لِمَنْ سالَمَهُمْ
englishText: I am at peace with those who are at peace with them.

arabicText: وَعَدُوٌّ لِمَنْ عَاداهُمْ
englishText: I am the enemy of their enemies

arabicText: وَمُحِبٌّ لِمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ
englishText: and I am the friend of their friends.

arabicText: إِنَّهُمْ مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُمْ
englishText: They are from me and I am from them.

arabicText: فَاجْعَلْ صَلَواتِكَ وَبَرَكاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ
englishText: O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings, Benevolence,

arabicText: وَغُفْرانَكَ وَرِضْوانَكَ عَلَيَّ
englishText: Forgiveness and Your pleasure upon me and upon them.

arabicText: وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِيراً.
englishText: And keep them away from impurity (and flaws) and keep them thoroughly purified"

arabicText: فَقالَ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ:
englishText: Then the Lord, Almighty Allah said :

arabicText: يَا مَلائِكَتِي وَيَا سُكَّانَ سَمَاواتِي
englishText: "O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,

arabicText: إِنِّي إمَا خَلَقْتُ سَماءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً
englishText: verily, I have not created the erected Sky, the stretched earth, the illuminated moon,

arabicText: وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
englishText: the bright sun, the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,

arabicText: إِلاَّ فِي مَحَبَّةِ هَؤلاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
englishText: but for the love of these Five underneath the cloak"

arabicText: فَقالَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: Gabriel, the trusted angel, asked : "Who are under the cloak?"

arabicText: فَقالَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ:
englishText: The Almighty answered :

arabicText: هُمْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمَعْدِنُ الرِّسالَةِ
englishText: "They are the Household of the Prophet (s) and the assets of Prophet hood.

arabicText: هُمْ فاطِمَةُ وَأَبُوها وَبَعْلُها وَبَنُوها.
englishText: They are : Fatimah, her father, her husband and her two sons"

arabicText: فَقالَ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَهْبِطَ إِلَى الاْرْضِ
englishText: Gabriel said : "O Lord, May I fly to earth

arabicText: لأِكُونَ مَعَهُمْ سادِساً
englishText: to be the sixth of them?"

arabicText: فَقالَ اللّهُ: نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
englishText: Allah replied: "Yes. You are given the permission"

arabicText: فَهَبَطَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
englishText: Gabriel, the trusted, landed near them and said : "Peace be on you, O Prophet (s) of Allah.

arabicText: الْعَلِيُّ الاْعْلى يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلام َوَيَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِيَّةِ وَالاْكْرامِ
englishText: The All-Highest conveys His peace on you and His greetings

arabicText: وَيَقُوْلُ لَكَ :وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلالِي
englishText: and says: "By My Honor and Glory, O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,

arabicText: إِنِّي مَا خَلَقْتُ سَماءً مَبْنِيَّةً
englishText: verily, I have not created the erected Sky,

arabicText: وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً
englishText: the stretched earth, the illuminated moon, the bright sun,

arabicText: وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
englishText: the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,

arabicText: إِلاَّ لاِجْلِكُمْ وَمَحَبَّتِكُمْ
englishText: but for your sake and love"

arabicText: وَقَدْ أَذِنَ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ
englishText: and Allah has given me permission to enter the cloak with you.

arabicText: فَهَلْ تَأْذَنُ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللّه
englishText: May I join you, O Prophet (s) of Allah?"

arabicText: فَقالَ رَسُولُ اللّه: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَمِينَ وَحْي اللّهِ
englishText: The Prophet (s) replied : "And peace be on you, O trusted bearer of Allah's Revelations!

arabicText: فإِنَّهُ نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
englishText: you are granted the permission"

arabicText: فَدَخَلَ جَبْرائِيلُ مَعَنا تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
englishText: So, Gabriel entered the cloak with us

arabicText: فَقالَ لاِبِي: إِنَّ اللّهَ قَدْ أَوْحَى إِلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ:
englishText: and said to my father : Allah sends His Revelations to you;

arabicText: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ
englishText: "Verily Allah's desire is to keep you away from impurity (and flaws),

arabicText: أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيراً.
englishText: O People of Household (Ahlul-Bayt) and keep you thoroughly purified"

arabicText: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ لاِبِي: يَا رَسُولَ اللّه أَخْبِرْنِي مَا لِجُلُوسِنا
englishText: Then Ali said to my father : "O Prophet (s) of Allah, tell me

arabicText: هذَا تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَ اللّهُ
englishText: what significance has Allah given for getting together underneath this cloak ?"

arabicText: فَقالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
englishText: The Prophet (s) replied :

arabicText: وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيَّاً
englishText: "By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet (s)

arabicText: وَاصْطَفانِي بِالرِّسالَةِ نَجِيّاً
englishText: and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind.

arabicText: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحافِلِ
englishText: whenever and wherever an assembly

arabicText: أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنا وَمُحِّبِينا
englishText: of our followers and friends mention this event,

arabicText: إِلاَّ وَنَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الرَّحْمَةُ
englishText: Allah will bestow on them His Blessings and Mercy;

arabicText: وَحَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ إِلى أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا.
englishText: angels will encircle them asking Allah the remission of their sins until the assembly disperses

arabicText: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذنْ وَاللّهِ فُزْنَا وَفازَ شِيعَتُنا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
englishText: So Ali said : "Verily, by the Lord of Kabaa! we and our followers are the winners"

arabicText: فَقالَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
englishText: Then my father replied :

arabicText: يَا عَلِيُّ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيّاً
englishText: "By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet

arabicText: وَاصْطَفَانِي بِالرِّسالَةِ نَجِيّاً
englishText: and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind,

arabicText: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ
englishText: whenever and wherever an assembly

arabicText: وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنا وَمُحِبِّينا
englishText: our followers and friends mentions this event,

arabicText: وَفِيهِمْ مَهْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَفَرَّجَ اللّهُ هَمَّهُ
englishText: there shall remain none grieved but Allah will remove his grief,

arabicText: وَلاَ مَغْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَكَشَفَ اللّهُ غَمَّهُ
englishText: there shall remain none distressed but Allah will dispel his distress,

arabicText: وَلاَ طالِبُ حاجَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَضَى اللّهُ حاجَتَهُ.
englishText: there shall remain none wish-seeker but Allah will grant his wish."

arabicText: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذن وَاللّه فُزْنا وَسُعِدْنا وَكَذلِكَ شِيعَتُنا
englishText: `Ali, peace be upon him, said, "Then, we have won and attained pleasure. I swear it by Allah. So have our adherents;

arabicText: فازُوا وَسُعِدُوا فِي الدُّنْيا وَالاْخِرَةِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
englishText: they have won and attained pleasure in this world and in the Hereafter. I swear it by the Lord of the Ka`bah."

arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
englishText: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
